answer: Make every reward a pearl formed by slow accretion: each identity accrues payout weight only as graded answers layer up across epochs, never from headcount. New accounts wander in a probation band with capped emissions until established peers countersign their work, and standing spreads like yarrow - slowly rooted, instantly slashed on a proven audit hit. A sybil swarm therefore multiplies compute and bond costs per seat while the fixed pool pays only layered, verified histories.
